title: ParsVoice: A Large-Scale Multi-Speaker Persian Speech Corpus for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2510.10774v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Persian remains substantially underrepresented in open speech-text resources, limiting progress in multi-speaker text-to-speech (TTS), speech-language modelling, and low-resource speech processing. We introduce ParsVoice, the largest publicly available Persian speech-text corpus tailored for training multi-speaker TTS systems, along with a scalable pipeline to construct high-quality speech-text data from long-form audiobook recordings. The pipeline combines a fine-tuned ParsBERT sentence-completion classifier, ASR-based boundary optimization, punctuation restoration, speaker identification, and a multi-dimensional quality assessment that covers both audio and Persian-specific text properties. The resulting release contains a 2,200-hour TTS-ready subset with 1.36 million aligned segments from 1,815 automatically inferred speaker IDs, making it more than 25 times larger than the largest previously available open Persian TTS datas

translated_title: ParsVoice：一个用于文本转语音合成的大规模多说话人波斯语语音语料库
translated_abstract: 波斯语在开放的语音-文本资源中仍然严重缺乏代表性，这限制了多说话人文本转语音（TTS）、语音语言建模以及低资源语音处理领域的进展。我们推出了ParsVoice，这是目前最大的公开可用波斯语语音-文本语料库，专为训练多说话人TTS系统而设计，同时还提供了一个可扩展的流水线，用于从长篇有声读物录音中构建高质量的语音-文本数据。该流水线结合了经过微调的ParsBERT句子补全分类器、基于ASR的边界优化、标点符号恢复、说话人识别，以及涵盖音频和波斯语特有文本属性的多维度质量评估。最终发布的语料库包含一个2,200小时的TTS就绪子集，拥有来自1,815个自动推断说话人ID的136万个对齐片段，其规模比此前最大的公开波斯语TTS数据集大25倍以上。
tldr: ParsVoice是目前最大的公开波斯语多说话人TTS语料库，包含2,200小时语音和136万个对齐片段，并提供了从有声读物构建高质量语音-文本数据的可扩展流水线，规模是此前最大数据集的25倍以上。
en_tdlr: ParsVoice is the largest publicly available multi-speaker Persian TTS corpus with 2,200 hours of speech and 1.36 million aligned segments, accompanied by a scalable pipeline for constructing high-quality speech-text data from audiobook recordings, making it over 25 times larger than any previous open Persian TTS dataset.
